title: skills(objectstack-data): teach an object extension's fieldPatches in the Object Extension Model section, once #28565 applies them
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

Filing gate: ③ the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #28728 (#28565), filed by the seat before ACCEPT as the review checklist requires. ⛔ Not a claim. Graded by this seat: p3 (documentation of a live key; the spec `.describe()` and `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` already teach it), under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).
Reach: an AI author working from the `objectstack-data` skill who wants a vendor field to read "Sector" instead of "Industry" learns only `fields` / `priority`, so it redeclares the field in `fields` (taking it over) instead of patching its display.

## Wanted

- `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, section "Object Extension Model": one short paragraph on `fieldPatches` — display keys only (`BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST`: label, description, inlineHelpText, placeholder, option labels by stored `value`); type, values and rules stay the owner's; tenant edits win, higher `priority` wins between extensions; a patch naming a missing field or option is refused at install and by `os validate`; a picklist-bound field's options are not patchable. One example, the `crm_account.industry` one from the changeset.
- Lands after PR #28728 merges (the key is `[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced]` on main until then). Governed path (`skills/**`): Tier H; publishes via `@objectstack/skills`.

Links back: #28565, PR #28728.

Blocked-by: #28565
